project_type: Full-stack: Node.js/Express backend + React/Vite frontend, MongoDB/Mongoose
build_system: No monorepo build step. Backend: node/nodemon. Frontend: Vite. Run separately.
test_framework: Jest with supertest (backend only). Config in server/package.json. Test files: server/__tests__/
build_command: cd server && npm start  (or npm run dev for nodemon)
verification_instructions: 1. cd server && npm test  — all Jest tests pass. 2. cd server && node src/app.js — server starts on port 5000, no crash. 3. cd client && npm run build — Vite build succeeds. 4. Manual smoke: register, login as analyst, confirm no admin-role escalation.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Paths use backslashes internally but Node.js normalizes. server/.env is the active env file. client has no .env yet — uses Vite proxy '/api' → localhost:5000.
contribution_requirements: Preserve all existing working functionality. Do not change UI design unless required for security fix. Do not replace Express/React/MongoDB/Mongoose/chokidar/Socket.IO. Keep SHA-256 as primary algorithm.
key_patterns: Controllers export named async functions. Routes import protect/authorize from middleware/auth.js. createAuditLog called directly inside controllers (not as middleware in most cases). emitToAll used extensively — needs replacing with targeted emits. MonitoredFile.sha256 is currently BOTH baseline and current hash — must be split. SecurityAlert has no createdBy field — needs adding. activeWatchers is a module-level Map in monitoringService.js.
directory_structure: file-integrity-checker/ — project root with .env, .gitignore, README.md. server/src/ — app.js, config/, controllers/, middleware/, models/, routes/, services/, utils/, websocket/, workers/. client/src/ — App.jsx, context/, components/, layouts/, pages/, services/, utils/. uploads/ — user-uploaded files (should NOT be served statically). reports/ — generated report files. logs/ — winston logs. demo-files/ — monitored file root.
